title: Crystallographic Torus Bundles: Obstructions, Elastic Sectors, and Global Acoustic Modes
summary: We formulate the global translational order parameter of a crystal with a fixed finite orientational background as a section of an affine torus bundle induced by the crystallographic extension $1\toΠ\toΓ\to P\to1$. For a principal $P$-bundle $Q$, the configuration bundle is $Y_Π=Q\times_P T_Π$. We identify two distinct global conditions associated with the same extension class: smooth configurations exist precisely when the pulled-back class $f_Q^*[c]\in H^2(X;Π_Q)$ vanishes, whereas parallel configurations exist precisely when the restriction of $[c]$ to the monodromy subgroup vanishes.…
